Deep inside Shadow Castle, Baron Muddle kept his treasure chest, stuffed full of stolen sound petals. Super Ninja crept in through a window...
The chest is on a big black rock.
But the chest was locked with a muddle-lock. How could Super Ninja open it?
Read the two words. Tap the one you choose.
Tap, tap, tap. The lock went click!
The lid pops up. So much stuff!
Petals whooshed out of the chest like a rainbow snowstorm, flying home to the World Flower. Now only the Sky Temple is left...
